question: What is the meaning of maintenance log in relation to use and operate phase?
description: Maintenance log in relation to the use and operate phase refers to a record or document that contains detailed information about the maintenance activities carried out on a building or its components during its usage. This log typically includes details such as the type of maintenance performed, the date of maintenance, any issues identified, parts replaced, and any other relevant information related to the upkeep of the building to ensure its proper functioning and longevity.
